notes: Exact Genelec 8020C source: official datasheet (https://assets.ctfassets.net/4zjnzn055a4v/8E5jwhoZgs828IQGqCq22/db2095584f86c40fb8112ba117055286/8020C_datasheet.pdf), with the exact-model archive page identifying 8020C and its 2013–2017 production period (https://www.genelec.com/previous-models/8020c) and the official operating manual describing it as a bi-amplified two-way active monitor (https://assets.ctfassets.net/4zjnzn055a4v/NdWcFNlq0eSKwq6yCiUkw/af60eb3d66a29ec131ee3fee1586d217/8020C_opman.pdf). The datasheet specifies free-field response 66 Hz–20 kHz (±2.5 dB); its separate -3 dB cutoff bounds are ≤65 Hz and ≥21 kHz, so those bounds are not substituted for the stated response range. It specifies one 105 mm (4 in) bass driver and one 19 mm treble driver (two drivers total). Bass and treble amplifiers each have short-term output of 20 W at an 8 Ω load; 40 W is their sum, recorded only as internal amplifier output, not loudspeaker power handling, and the source does not state RMS for these outputs. The 8 Ω amplifier test load is not the speaker's impedance. Sensitivity remains unavailable: the listed -6 dBu input level for 100 dB SPL at 1 m is an active monitor's signal-input level, not a passive sensitivity rating. The 10 kΩ balanced XLR input is not loudspeaker impedance. Resonant frequency and voice-coil size are not stated. No response-point table or directivity data was imported: although the datasheet includes a directivity figure, its associated tabulation is headed “Genelec Oy 8020” and dated 6 Apr 2005, which does not unambiguously establish the 8020C revision for point-level data; retain only the exact-model response limits.

UNAVAILABLE — the exact Genelec product/revision 7060C could not be confirmed. Genelec's official 7060A archive page says that model was produced from 2002 to 2006 and replaced by the 7060B and later the 7360A (https://www.genelec.com/previous-models/7060a); its separate 7060B archive page says 7060B was produced from 2007 to 2016 and replaced by 7360A (https://www.genelec.com/previous-models/7060b). The official 7060C archive route returns Not Found (https://www.genelec.com/previous-models/7060c), and the manufacturer archive lists the documented predecessor/successor records (https://www.genelec.com/previous-models). This leaves the intended 7060C identity unresolved; it does not establish a substitute model. No 7060A, 7060B, or 7050C specifications are transferred, and all physical/acoustic fields and active/driver-count facts remain N/A until the exact identity is established.
